fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank’s policy.
fees.annual_note: The annual fee is charged every year and may be waived if you meet the bank’s spending conditions.
fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹4 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 2% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (2%):₹100 → ₹2₹1,000 → ₹20₹10,000 → ₹200₹1,00,000 → ₹2,000
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card (minimum ₹500, if applicable).
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: 1% of the transaction amount + GST will be charged on railway ticket purchase
